anchor.source: C maps/m45_55.jm2:8253 (obj 3110 death_cannonball_blue)

steps.comment: Single-item ground spawn that respawns; the blue ball goes on the pedestal at 2894,3562 (quest_death.rs2:92 obj_find(0_45_55_14_42)).

args.source: Stand tile for the 2894,3562 (blue) pedestal: from here (or 2893,3561) it is the only death_stone_mechanism_corner within Chebyshev 1, so place-blue-ball's nearest-within-radius-1 selection (families/mod.rs:2461-2469, reach.rs:556-598) cannot pick a sibling; 2893,3563 ties it with the unused corner 2894,3564 and 2894/2895,3561 tie it with the yellow one.

steps.comment: GAP-exact-stand: no family can request exact arrival. The walk radius is clamped to at least 1 (families/mod.rs:1100), the native walk settles as soon as the player is within that radius (native/walk.rs:56-61, api/snapshot/native.rs:86-101), and a use_on loc target cannot be pinned to a tile (families/mod.rs:2180-2183); the pedestals offer no op, so an exact-tile interact is not available either. The exact tile is therefore enforced only by this settle (near radius 0): the host walk normally carries the player onto the clicked tile within the 8 s window, but a player who is already within 1 tile when the step begins (restart, manual nudge) is not moved and the step fails closed and parks instead of letting the placement pick a sibling pedestal. Recovery: step onto the tile by hand and Start.

quest_death.rs2:80-101: using any stone ball on a mechanism pedestal drops it there for 1000 ticks; when blue 2894,3562 / yellow 2895,3562 / red 2894,3563 / purple 2895,3563 / green 2895,3564 are all present and %death_equiproom=60 the door unlocks (stage 70). 'There is already a stone ball here.' if the tile is taken.
